name: Hearthside
description: A classic, elegant Christmas: evergreen, cranberry and gold, with large, easy-to-read text and plain wording. Starred items are Top Picks.

text.title: My Christmas List
text.welcome: Thank you for thinking of me! The ones marked Top Pick are my favorites. Tap the {i} on a photo to see sizes, colors and notes.
text.empty.title: No gifts match
text.empty.text: Nothing matches those choices. Try clearing a filter.
text.hint: Sizes and notes are in here
text.viewAria: View {name} at {shop} (opens in a new tab)
text.lootedNote: Someone already bought this. Thank you!
text.lootCopy: Marking it lets other family and friends know, so nobody buys it twice. {owner} won't see it.
text.toast: Thank you! {qty}{name} is marked as purchased.
text.planner.idle: Type in how much you'd like to spend, and I'll suggest gifts from the list that fit.
text.planner.claimHint: Bought one? Press "I bought this" on its card so nobody doubles up.
text.error.title: The list isn't available right now
text.error.line: I couldn't load the list. Please try refreshing in a minute.
